title: Mara Weber
text:
I am a PhD student in Social Research Methods in the Department of Methodology at the London School of Economics and Political Science, supervised by Thomas Robinson and Sara Hobolt. My PhD is funded by an LSE PhD Studentship.
My doctoral research examines how British political elites have constructed and represented marginalization over the past century. Methodologically, I work on developing validation approaches for computationally generated text measurements. My broader research interests include the reproduction of inequalities and the application of natural language processing in sociology and political science.
Before starting my PhD, I was a Predoctoral Researcher in Computational Social Science on the ESRC-funded project The Politics of Memory in the Department of Political Science at University College London, where I am now a research and teaching assistant.
I hold an M.A. in Sociology and Social Research and a B.A. in Sociology from the University of Bremen.
Feel free to contact me at m.weber1@lse.ac.uk. You can also view my full CV here.
